title: Create analysis_cache DB table and repository with tenant-scoped hashing
acceptance_criteria: analysis_cache table added to Drizzle schema with columns: id, tenant_id, resume_hash, section, response_json, created_at, expires_at
AnalysisCacheRepository extends BaseRepository with cache-specific methods
getCachedAnalysis(resumeHash, section) returns cached result or null
setCachedAnalysis(resumeHash, section, response) upserts cache entry
Cache entries are automatically scoped by tenant_id via RLS
Resume hash computed from raw_text content (SHA-256)
